headline: Congress named a Florida post office building after Officer Robert German.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 9930 Conroy Windermere Road in Windermere, Florida, as the Officer Robert German Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing at the site.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 17, 2020.
